description:
Important: This is a pre-owned product and is not in brand-new cosmetic condition. Scratches, scuffs and other reasonable signs of previous use may be present and will vary between individual units. Product images are for model reference only. Cosmetic imperfections do not affect the intended functionality of the product.

Grade A – Approx. 90% New
Excellent overall condition. May have minor scratches, marks or light signs of previous use.

Grade B – Approx. 80% New
Good functional condition with more visible scratches, scuffs or signs of previous use.

Every Pre-Owned HITWAY is inspected for:

Motor operation

Battery and charging

Display and controls

Braking system

Lights and electrical functions

Tyres and wheels

Basic riding functionality

Featherweight Design

The HITWAY BK19 redefines the road e-bike experience with its featherlight aluminum alloy frame, weighing in at just 20 kilograms. Effortlessly navigate urban streets or tackle challenging terrains with agility and ease, all while enjoying the ultimate in lightweight design.

Power and Endurance

Powered by a robust 36V 12Ah battery, the BK19 delivers an impressive range of 40-80 kilometers on a single charge. Whether you're commuting, exploring, or simply enjoying a leisurely ride, this e-bike ensures you never run out of power when you need it most.

Tire Traction, Stability, and Comfort

These 700c*42c tires offer exceptional grip for easy climbing and stable descending, ensuring you stay in control at all times.

Fashionable Elegance

The BK19 isn't just about performance; it's a statement of style. Its fashionable appearance turns heads wherever you go. With sleek lines and modern design elements, this e-bike is as eye-catching as it is functional. Ride in style and make a lasting impression on the road.

Strength Without Compromise

The BK19 seamlessly blends lightweight construction with robust strength. You'll experience better cruising ability without sacrificing durability, ensuring that your e-bike can handle the rigors of daily use and challenging terrains while remaining remarkably agile.
